note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is in the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh/usfm/; re-verified for this job 2026-10-09: rom/mat/col/1co/1th/jas/1pe/1jn/jhn return 200, 1sa/psa 404, so no Old Testament). OT epigraphs reuse an already-shipped Amharic work's wording verbatim (source_file names it).

The mirror's verse BRIDGES hide text: it carries 1 Thessalonians 5:17-18 and Romans 1:20 under bridged `\v 17-19` / `\v 20-22` markers whose text is a later verse, so neither is readable there. Romans 1:20 therefore reuses key-teachings-of-jonathan-edwards.am.json (a partial rendering of the verse) and 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18 reuses school-of-prayer.am.json. 1 Corinthians 10:31 sits under a bridged `\v 31-33` marker, but its text is 10:31's own, so it is quoted from the mirror.

The English epigraphs are simplified child paraphrases ("— from Psalm 16"); following the shipped am children's editions, each quotes the Bible's own wording for the part the English means, with … for words left out, and cites `— ከ<Book> <chapter>`. Every epigraph is an exact substring of its source; no epigraph was re-personed. The body quotes no further scripture.

Brother Lawrence's own sayings are paraphrased for children. Chapter 6's «…ሥራዎቻችንን በመለወጥ ላይ የተመሠረተ አይደለም፤ ይልቁንም … ለራሳችን ብለን የምናደርገውን ለእግዚአብሔር ብለን በማድረግ ላይ ነው» and chapter 7's «የሥራ ጊዜ ከጸሎት ጊዜ የተለየ…» deliberately echo purpose-in-prayer.am.json's rendering of the same two sayings. That file (and clothed-with-strength-and-dignity) renders "presence of God" as «ሀልዎት»; this book uses «መገኘት» because the plan card family-devotions-talking-with-god already quotes the title «የእግዚአብሔርን መገኘት መለማመድ (ለልጆች)» — a reviewer choosing ሀልዎት should change the title, the body and the card's quotation together.
